checks.detail: Fresh candidate-bound MCP state, source, scene, logs, and screenshots were reviewed against the release_convergence PRD boundary.

Ordinary movement changed Warden position while preserving y=0.05 and plane_error=0; Space dash advanced to recovery with consumed generation, and Escape paused then resumed the active run. High-angle camera remained perspective and gameplay-oriented.

Runtime receipts showed deterministic target selection, accepted lantern attacks, anticipation/onset/impact/hit-resolution/damage/recovery/completion phases, bounded hit counts, and a committed reward drop without duplicate active ledgers. Audio waveform capture was not performed.

Observed pooled enemies had off-camera approach/telegraph/recovery states, bounded live caps, telegraph admission, hurt/death retirement, and clean pool return. All four ordinary roles and boss branches were not reached in this bounded run.
Authoritative XP and reward fields were observed during active play, but the ordinary three-card draft, overflow transaction, debounced selection, and post-choice combat mutation were not reached.

Gameplay and pause/result frames showed authored typography, compact health/XP/wave/weapon/dash presentation, contextual guidance with live WASD/Space/H glyphs and an illustration, and truthful failure/retry state. Settings and 200% scale persistence were not exercised. coverage.baseline.survivor_onboarding_input_guida.aeacca15e82a=pass;
Title-to-gameplay, ordinary failure to Result, Retry to a new run_serial, pooled enemy retirement to zero live actors, and pause/resume were observed without runtime errors or stale active entities.

The exact project was bound first; candidate source, InputMap, runtime digests, editor spatial inspection, custom camera view, screenshots, and final editor/runtime log reads were collected. No tester_* fixture actions were present in project.godot.

White-box WeaponInventory exposed distinct focused_bolt, threat_sweep, and persistent_orbit strategies with different cadence, area, range, damage, duration, and hit interval. Only the starting lantern was exercised in ordinary play; upgrade paths and all-weapon end-run diversity remain unobserved.

Wave-1 director state, live cap, spawn budget fields, and capped telegraph admission were observed. Waves 2-5, elite escalation, Bellkeeper phases, victory, and terminal spawn shutdown were not reached.

Runtime bounds exposed one authored cemetery with external depth margins, navigation region, landmark anchors, and a bounded 68.9 by 64.8 world; editor inspection showed coherent cemetery geometry. A custom derived top-down view preserved source_camera_unchanged=true. Full perimeter traversal was not completed. coverage.baseline.survivor_arena_spatial_integrit.150a2175f98f=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.fps_enemy_occupancy_occlusion.586166354018=insufficient_evidence;

Runtime semantic states covered idle, dash recovery, attack phases, enemy telegraph/recovery/hurt/death, and lantern light presentation ownership; final logs were clean. A causal audio capture and full-density VFX/light audit were not available.

Authored title/gameplay guidance, pause actions, Result failure summary, Retry, and Return-to-Title affordances were visible and navigable with keyboard semantics. Credits, settings persistence, gamepad focus, victory result, and full replay matrix were not reached.

The candidate reports profile_native_qualification_pending=true, profile_renderer_gate_status=pending_native_renderer, profile_status=idle, zero samples, and no p95; the required native 1920x1080 three-cycle 25-40-enemy qualification is therefore unavailable. coverage.baseline.fps_runtime_stutter.6b972c8aebe3=insufficient_evidence;

An ordinary failure branch and clean Retry were reached, but the seven-to-ten-minute victory route, three independent successful build shapes, Bellkeeper completion, credits/provenance verification, and replay remain unqualified. coverage.baseline.survivor_reward_feedback.f3a12bf95b42=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.survivor_enemy_vitality.2e8fe7fe7b3c=pass; coverage.baseline.survivor_choice_visual_hierarch.c96a93673ada=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.closure_candidate.3484f713a391=insufficient_evidence;

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime evidence against the PRD requirements for phase release_convergence.

Use ordinary keyboard and gamepad-equivalent input to verify camera-relative planar movement, collision sliding, visual facing, dash anticipation/invulnerability/recovery/cooldown, high-angle camera framing and clean pause/resume. Judge only behavior introduced by the active phase; reject hidden threats, contradictory velocity, stuck input or camera modes that drift toward FPS/TPS play.

Bind one stable event chain from cooldown and deterministic legal target selection through emitted attack, hit policy, damage, hurt, exactly-once death and drop. Require visible and audible anticipation, onset, impact and recovery without manual-fire drift, duplicate damage, freed targets, inert attacks or presentation disconnected from state.

Exercise active enemy roles from validated off-camera spawn through approach, separation, telegraph, attack, hurt, death, drop and pool return. Reject collision or out-of-bounds spawns, root sliding, static poses, first-frame damage, unreadable overlap, dead actors moving, permanent clumps, blocked escape lanes and stale pooled state.

Verify enemy reward, collection, experience threshold and overflow, one paused three-choice draft, debounced selection, authoritative build mutation and resumed play with an observable changed attack or utility. Reject duplicate drafts, held-confirm double choice, blank/inert cards, false values, lost overflow or gameplay clocks advancing under draft.

Require every introduced health, experience, level, wave/run, weapon, dash and boss field to match authoritative runtime state while leaving the arena readable. Judge native, fullscreen and supported UI scales; reject default fonts, debug labels, text piles, opaque blue/purple blocks, generic rounded cards, clipped controls and top-left-only pages.

From title through gameplay, pause, player failure and retry, verify single authoritative run transitions and a clean baseline after three restarts. Reject stale actors, timers, signals, pools, pause reasons, input ownership, attacks, effects or audio, and any state that requires restarting the application to recover.

Bind black-box ordinary play and white-box authoritative snapshots, events, transforms, animation/audio owners, logs and distributed frames to the exact candidate. Deterministic setup may reach legal branches, but normal runtime systems and input must cause the accepted outcome.

Exercise every weapon and representative upgrade path. Require focused bolts, close sweep and orbiting area control to retain distinct targeting, cadence, geometry, hit policy, feedback and build consequences rather than renamed copies of one projectile.

Verify five data-driven wave states, composition escalation, elite pressure and the Bellkeeper's two phases, telegraphs, summons or lane pressure, recovery window, exactly-once defeat and victory. The director must honor live caps and stop after terminal state.

Compare ordinary runtime views with the frozen Mournlight visual reference. Require one coherent bounded cemetery, grounded collision, keeper post, mausoleum and cracked bell landmarks, clear escape lanes, readable silhouettes, coherent scale/materials and no visible stand-ins.

Inspect accepted component/source values and every active animation state, moonlight/lantern hierarchy, causal bounded VFX and semantic audio layer under real crowd density. Reject unrelated fallback clips, sliding/dead movement, overdark or clipped light, leaked loops, hum, unexpected speech, generic tones and effects that hide telegraphs.

Navigate title, settings, upgrade, pause, death, victory and result pages across the full viewport with mouse, keyboard and gamepad focus. Verify persisted audio/window/UI-scale/effect settings, authored iconography and typography, truthful summaries and clean replay/title flow.

Profile the representative final wave and boss at 1920x1080 with 25-40 ordinary enemies, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI and audio. Require stable frame-time distribution, bounded high-churn work and no growth across three complete retries.

Play the complete seven-to-ten-minute title-to-result run, including failure and victory branches, three viable build shapes, statistics, credits/provenance and replay. Reject placeholders, debug presentation, missing required content or unresolved release-relevant regressions.
